linesSheWrites.text: You like it slow. The build-up does something to you, and I noticed.
linesSheWrites.author: her

linesSheWrites.text: Thursday. The big presentation. You tried to hide the nerves. It didn't work on me.
linesSheWrites.author: her

linesSheWrites.text: Hotel bar, rain on the glass. You sat closer than you needed to.
linesSheWrites.author: her

linesSheWrites.text: You left before I could tell you what I was thinking when you walked in. I still might.
linesSheWrites.author: her

returnLines.text: You came back on the Friday. Same stools, less rain, and you sat a little closer.
returnLines.author: her

rejected.note: You mentioned therapy. That stays yours. I don't write it down.

slower.text: Slower. You want to be made to wait. Noted.

more direct.text: When you ask me something, you want it straight. I can do straight.

less talking.text: Fewer words from me. You'd rather I show you.

somewhere else.text: You wanted out of the bar. Somewhere with a view, and fewer people.

openers.real: It's Friday. How did Thursday go? I've been wondering since you left. Come here and tell me.
openers.scene: Same stool at the bar, or somewhere quieter tonight? You still don't know what I was going to say to you.
openers.sceneWithFact: Same stool at the bar, or somewhere quieter tonight? And it's Friday. How did Thursday go? I want all of it.
openers.sceneNoFact: Same stool at the bar, or somewhere quieter tonight? You still don't know what I was going to say to you.
openers.realNoFact: You're back. I'd started to wonder if the rain had kept you. Sit with me.
